create_environment_config: create an Environment config with id, reward_space, observation_space, max_episode_steps, and wrappers
make_compiler_env: construct a CompilerEnv from an Environment config with wrappers and time limits applied
wrap_compiler_env: wrap a CompilerEnv with a named wrapper class and constructor arguments using EnvironmentWrapperConfig
validate_wrapper_class: validate that a wrapper class name resolves to an imported class in the environment module
configure_rllib_environment: configure an Environment with a custom rllib_id for RLlib registration logging
